name: viewtower.ai AI-Coding Governance platform — tool coverage v18
description: Feature-based Claude Code + Codex developer rules. Deny first, then allow, otherwise deny; general applies universally. Based on uploaded Viewtower v16 plus established v17 deduplication and native Claude tool names. Read/Grep/Glob now match observed tool names. IMPORTANT: bare Grep/Glob/LSP and executable scripts cannot guarantee project-only or secret-safe access unless gateway inspects tool arguments and the process sandbox enforces file/network access. Codex apply_patch and shell adapters must enforce FileEdit/DeleteFile/Shell policies on structured inputs; unrecognized MCP/remote tools remain denied. V19 is a feature-group-local deduplication of V18; no new permissions or protective capabilities. Assumes simple-star wildcard semantics and the existing deny-first/default-deny policy.
